notes: The result rows for foundFiles/foundCommits/foundIssues are v3's own input, unrepresentable_commits/unrepresentable_issues counted only in v4 (V3-PARITY.md §4.2) -- trace.ts:167-183 itself only echoes the four summary counts and does not enumerate hits back to the caller. A real hash shorter than 40/64 hex (e.g. a git short hash) has no full-length representation in either v3 or v4; V3-PARITY.md routes it to unrepresentable_commits rather than a fabricated full hash.
